component.name: LocalGallery (Reference)
component.summary: Frozen leftover GTK UI — same library as the iOS app

description.p: LocalGallery treats a plain folder as the library. Sidecars travel with the files. This leftover Linux build is a frozen reference: a GNOME laptop layout and a collapsed Mecha Comet layout (540×620 at 2×). The kit shell is `localgallery` (`com.j23n.LocalGallery`).
